title: feat(objects): built-in and example objects carry a palette colour by business family
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ88qRZGKXN4d5GAiBhRLidG1)_

Fixes #36592
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 控制台里，管理员在设置、个人账户和记录页看到的 36 个内置对象图标，从全灰变成按业务家族上色；三个示例应用的对象也一并上色。
- 属于对象图标配色这项能力的收尾：平台自己的对象先把颜色用起来，作者照着学。
- 只改图标底色，不碰数据、字段和接口；颜色不合适可以整体撤回，无副作用。
- 要你做的一件事：合并前看下面的「家族 → 颜色」表和「判为内部」清单，定稿或改色。

## What changes

Every object a console user can reach now declares `color` beside its `icon`, one palette name per business family. Objects nobody opens keep no `color` and stay the designed neutral `gray`. No spec, schema, palette, renderer or test change; 67 one-line additions across 62 object files, plus one patch changeset per moved published package (7).

### Measured on main (c0eecb1f8)

- Object definitions in the tree: 137 `*.object.ts` files under `packages/**` and `examples/**` (outside test and fixture directories) holding 145 object literals; 0 declare a `color`. The card's "118 files with `isSystem: true`" counted every file carrying the flag, and most of those carry it on an execution context (`{ isSystem: true }` in `core`, `objectql`, `plugin-auth`, `metadata-protocol`, `spec`), not on an object. The platform's own objects number 108 (`sys_*`, 105 of them `isSystem: true`), all in `*.object.ts` files.
- `examples/**`: app-showcase 24 objects, app-crm 6, app-todo 1 — none with a `color`.

### How "a user sees it" was decided — from code, not from names

An object is visible when at least one of these holds on main:

1. **App navigation** — an entry `type: 'object'` with its `objectName` in the Setup app (`setup-nav.contributions.ts` and the plugin contributions in plugin-approvals, plugin-sharing, plugin-webhooks, plugin-auth, service-messaging) or the Account app (`account.app.ts`). This is also the whole **search** scope: the command palette and the search results page search exactly the active app's `type: 'object'` nav entries (`CommandPalette.tsx`, `SearchResultsPage.tsx`), so `enable.searchable` alone exposes nothing.
2. **Record pages** — a `record:related_list` on a page of a visible object (`sys-user.page.ts`, `sys-organization.page.ts`, `sys-queue.page.ts`, the audit-log related list).
3. **Setup component pages built over one object** — `audit:log` (`sys_audit_log`), `approvals:inbox` (`sys_approval_request`), `security:position-holders` (`sys_user_position`), `security:permission-set-assignment` (`sys_user_permission_set`).

The renderer draws the colour in exactly those places: `ObjectIconTile` is used by the nav menu, object and record headers, related lists, record pointer cells, hover cards, search results, recent items and the command palette.

### Family → colour (platform, 36 objects: 35 `sys_*` plus the DocuSign connector's)

| Family | Colour | Objects |
|:---|:---|:---|
| People & organisation | `blue` | `sys_user`, `sys_organization`, `sys_business_unit`, `sys_business_unit_member`, `sys_team`, `sys_member`, `sys_invitation` |
| Security & access | `purple` | `sys_api_key`, `sys_session`, `sys_account`, `sys_oauth_application`, `sys_sso_provider`, `sys_scim_connection_credential`, `sys_user_permission_set`, `sys_user_position`, `sys_sharing_rule`, `sys_record_share` |
| Approvals & work routing | `orange` | `sys_approval_request`, `sys_approval_action`, `sys_approval_delegation`, `sys_queue`, `sys_queue_member`, `sys_assignment_rule` |
| Messaging & notifications | `pink` | `sys_inbox_message`, `sys_notification`, `sys_notification_preference`, `sys_notification_template` |
| Integrations | `teal` | `sys_webhook`, `sys_http_delivery`, `docusign_envelope` (the DocuSign connector app's object) |
| Reference data & preferences | `green` | `sys_exchange_rate`, `sys_unit`, `sys_work_calendar`, `sys_work_calendar_exception`, `sys_user_preference` |
| Audit | `amber` | `sys_audit_log` |

Seven families, seven distinct hues; `red` stays unused (it reads as an alarm), `gray` stays the internal neutral.

### Family → colour (examples, 31 objects)

| App | Family | Colour | Objects |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| app-showcase | People & organisations | `blue` | `showcase_account`, `showcase_contact`, `showcase_team`, `showcase_business_unit` |
| app-showcase | Projects & work | `orange` | `showcase_project`, `showcase_task`, `showcase_project_membership` |
| app-showcase | Finance | `green` | `showcase_invoice`, `showcase_invoice_line`, `showcase_product`, `showcase_expense_report`, `showcase_expense_line` |
| app-showcase | Communication & notes | `pink` | `showcase_announcement`, `showcase_private_note`, `showcase_inquiry`, `showcase_client_brief` |
| app-showcase | External data | `teal` | `showcase_ext_customer`, `showcase_ext_order` |
| app-showcase | Settings & field demos | `amber` | `showcase_category`, `showcase_preference`, `showcase_cascade`, `showcase_field_zoo`, `showcase_semantic_zoo`, `showcase_semantic_zoo_legacy` |
| app-crm | Accounts & contacts | `blue` | `crm_account`, `crm_contact` |
| app-crm | Sales pipeline | `green` | `crm_lead`, `crm_opportunity`, `crm_opportunity_line_item` |
| app-crm | Activities | `pink` | `crm_activity` |
| app-todo | Work | `orange` | `todo_task` |

The example families reuse the platform's meanings where they overlap (people `blue`, work `orange`, communication `pink`, external `teal`).

### Judged internal — no `color`, stay `gray` (73 platform objects, one line per group)

- **No data door at all** (`enable.apiEnabled: false`, so no console page can list or open them): the OAuth stores (`sys_oauth_access_token`, `sys_oauth_refresh_token`, `sys_oauth_consent`, `sys_oauth_client_assertion`, `sys_oauth_client_resource`, `sys_oauth_resource`) and `sys_jwks`; `sys_cloud_binding_credential`; `sys_connector_connection`, `sys_connector_credential`, `sys_flow_credential`; `sys_approval_token`; `sys_channel_account`, `sys_channel_user_link`, `sys_user_device`; `sys_lifecycle_state`, `sys_recycle_bin` (the Recycle Bin page is its own component), `sys_seed_landed_key`.
- **Sign-in library internals with no nav entry or page**: `sys_verification`, `sys_device_code`, `sys_two_factor`, `sys_team_member`, the SCIM projection tables (`sys_scim_user`, `sys_scim_group`, `sys_scim_group_member`, `sys_scim_subject`, `sys_scim_projection_grant`, `sys_scim_identity_tombstone`, `sys_scim_connection_binding`), `sys_idp_group_mapping`, `sys_personal_view`.
- **Engine queues, run logs and delivery bookkeeping**: `sys_job`, `sys_job_queue`, `sys_job_run`, `sys_import_job`, `sys_email`, `sys_identity_email`, `sys_email_template`, `sys_automation_run`, `sys_flow_dispatch`, `sys_sync_run`, `sys_notification_delivery`, `sys_notification_receipt`, `sys_presence`, `sys_assignment_cursor`, `sys_approval_approver`, `sys_share_link`, `sys_audience_binding_suggestion`, `sys_mailbox`, `sys_mail_message`, `sys_mail_association`, `sys_file`, `sys_upload_session`.
- **Metadata, migration, settings and ledger plumbing**: `sys_metadata`, `sys_metadata_audit`, `sys_metadata_commit`, `sys_metadata_history`, `sys_metadata_activation`, `sys_migration`, `sys_migration_journal`, `sys_setting`, `sys_setting_audit`, `sys_platform_setting`, `sys_platform_setting_audit`, `sys_secret`, `sys_trusted_key`, `sys_audit_amendment`, `sys_audit_checkpoint`, `sys_audit_signing_key`.
- **Collaboration rows drawn by their own panels, never as an object page**: `sys_comment`, `sys_comment_reaction`, `sys_activity`, `sys_attachment`.

## Tests

No test changed: no test pins an object's icon output or the absence of `color`. Local readings on the final head are under Verification.

## Acceptance notes

- `examples/app-multi-package` (`crm_account`, `crm_order`) declares no `icon`, so there is nothing to put a colour beside; left as is. `examples/embed-objectql` has no console. The `create-objectstack` blank template's `blank_note` and the QA fixture `dc_account` are not example apps and were left out to keep this card's surface.
- `sys_package_installation` appears on the System Overview dashboard but is not defined in this repository.
- Teaching AI authors to pick a colour in `skills/**` is the card's named follow-up, filed when this lands.

## Verification

Two-minute check: run `OS_PORT=3000 pnpm dev`, open Setup: Users / Organization / Teams draw on blue tiles, API Keys and Sessions on purple, Approval Requests on orange, Exchange Rates on green, Webhooks on teal.

Files to read first: `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts` (the one-line shape every file repeats), `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/objects/sys-queue.object.ts` (a plugin object in a different family), `examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/invoice.object.ts` (three objects in one file).

Local readings on head `85f3b305` (CI runs the full farm):

<details><summary>Build, typecheck, tests, derived gates</summary>

- Build: dependency closures of the 7 published packages, the DocuSign connector and the three examples — lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `typecheck`: 11 of 11 packages (platform-objects, plugin-security, plugin-sharing, plugin-approvals, plugin-audit, plugin-webhooks, service-messaging, connector-app-docusign, example-showcase, example-crm, example-todo) — VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `test`: platform-objects 125 files / 2126 tests; service-messaging 80 / 1077; plugin-sharing 77 / 1626 (+11 skipped); plugin-approvals 127 / 1865; plugin-webhooks 27 / 322; plugin-audit 109 / 1815; plugin-security 287 / 7238 (+45 skipped) — all passed. Example app tests declared to CI.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` (70 commands derived from the diff): 68 exit 0. 2 NOT MEASURED, exit 3 prerequisite: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (its fixture commit is outside this shallow clone) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needs `dist/` of packages outside this diff's closure) — both run in CI.
- `overlap-check.mjs`: merges cleanly with origin/main.

</details>
